data.taskBrief:
Create a new employee record for new-hire onboarding using the Xero Accounting API (XeroAPI)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request creates employee records, covering the task. No requests were dropped.

AUTH
  OAuth 2.0 access token authentication, sent in the header as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. The access token must be supplied by the caller and may expire after 30 minutes. Also provide the required Xero tenant identifier in the `xero-tenant-id` header.

BASE URL
  https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0

STEPS
  1. PUT /Employees?summarizeErrors=false
     Params:
       xero-tenant-id: string — your Xero tenant identifier, in the `xero-tenant-id` header.
       Content-Type: string — `application/json`, in the `Content-Type` header.
       Employees: array of employee objects — in the JSON body under the `Employees` field.
       Employees[0].FirstName: string — `Nick`, in the employee object; use the new hire's first name.
       Employees[0].LastName: string — `Fury`, in the employee object; use the new hire's last name.
       Employees[0].ExternalLink: object — optional example `{ "Url": "http://twitter.com/#!/search/Nick+Fury" }`, in the employee object.
       Employees[0].EmployeeID: UUID — optional, for example `e1ada26b-a10e-4065-a941-af34b53740e3`, in the employee object.
       Employees[0].Status: string — optional, for example `ACTIVE`, in the employee object.
       Employees[0].ExternalLink.LinkType, ExternalLink.Url, ExternalLink.Description: strings — optional, in the nested `ExternalLink` object.
       Employees[0].StatusAttributeString: string and ValidationErrors: array of `{Message: string}` objects — optional response/status-related fields shown by the schema; normally do not send validation results when creating the employee.
       Also accepts multiple employee objects in the `Employees` array.
     Returns:
       200 OK: an object containing `Id`, `Status`, `ProviderName`, `DateTimeUTC`, and an `Employees` array. The returned employee example includes `EmployeeID`, `Status`, `FirstName`, `LastName`, `ExternalLink`, and `UpdatedDateUTC`.
       400 Bad Request: an object containing `ErrorNumber`, `Type`, `Message`, and an `Elements` array whose entries can contain `ValidationErrors` arrays with `Message` fields.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as JSON with an `Employees` array; the request schema labels the raw body as text, but the required content type is `application/json`.
  - `xero-tenant-id` is required and is separate from the OAuth 2.0 access token.
  - Keep `summarizeErrors=false` to receive a 200 response containing successful employees and any per-object validation errors when applicable.
  - A validation failure is represented by HTTP 400 with `Message`/`ValidationErrors` details; inspect those fields before retrying.
